description: This Java class 'WorkEffortWorker' provides utility methods for handling 'WorkEffort' entities within the OFBiz framework, including retrieving lowest-level work efforts and removing duplicates.

classes.name: WorkEffortWorker
classes.description: A utility class for managing work effort entities, including fetching related work efforts and eliminating duplicates.

methods.name: getLowestLevelWorkEfforts
methods.description: Retrieves the lowest level work efforts associated with a given work effort ID and association type, with optional parameters for association endpoints.

methods.name: removeDuplicateWorkEfforts
methods.description: Removes duplicate work efforts from the provided list based on their workEffortId, returning a list with unique entries.
